readme:
# SGLang 前缀 KV 缓存与叶节点 LRU

## 1. 问题

寻找最长缓存前缀，并在容量限制下只驱逐未被占用的叶节点。

将 radix tree 展开为每token一个节点的语义模型；模拟前缀共享、LRU和活动请求pin，不存储真实KV tensor。

原文: [SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.07104) · Section 3: RadixAttention, longest-prefix reuse, leaf-first LRU and reference counters.

## 2. 核心公式

$$
h(x)=\max\{j:x_{:j}\in C\},\qquad e=\arg\min_{p\in\operatorname{leaves}(C)\setminus P}(\operatorname{lastUse}(p),p).
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `radix_cache_step(cache: dict, prompt: tuple[int, ...], capacity: int, clock: int, pinned: tuple = ()) -> tuple[dict, int]` — Copied cache after prefix reuse/insertion/eviction, and matched prefix length.

先逐token匹配，不允许把后缀相同当成前缀命中。复制cache后更新时间戳；空间不足时找无孩子且不受保护的最旧节点。一次删一个叶子，祖先成为叶子后才允许删除。

## 4. 本题约定

cache 为 {token元组:上次使用整数时刻}，不含空根且必须前缀闭合。prompt 为非负int的非空tuple，capacity 计非根token节点，clock 不小于缓存已有时刻。pinned 给出被运行请求使用的缓存节点，其全部祖先都受保护。本轮prompt路径也受保护；同LRU时按token元组排序。返回 (新cache, 复用token数)，失败也不修改输入。

## 5. 交互图

顺序回放六个有共享系统提示词的请求，使用容量 7 与 12 的缓存，对比零缓存的prefill token数，并检查节点容量。

T3 使用实际待测函数生成实验，网页参考图使用参考实现。数值来自教学样本，不表示GPU吞吐或完整模型质量。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

结合所引章节，解释本题保留了哪些维度、状态或调度约束，再扩展实验样本并保持已有契约。更大模型、真实设备与通信代价需要单独测量。

en.readme:
# SGLang Prefix KV Cache and Leaf-Only LRU

## 1. Problem

Find the longest cached prefix and evict only unpinned leaves under a capacity limit.

A token-node expansion of radix-tree semantics modeling shared prefixes, LRU and active-request pins, without storing actual KV tensors.

Source: [SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.07104) · Section 3: RadixAttention, longest-prefix reuse, leaf-first LRU and reference counters.

## 2. Core equations

$$
h(x)=\max\{j:x_{:j}\in C\},\qquad e=\arg\min_{p\in\operatorname{leaves}(C)\setminus P}(\operatorname{lastUse}(p),p).
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `radix_cache_step(cache: dict, prompt: tuple[int, ...], capacity: int, clock: int, pinned: tuple = ()) -> tuple[dict, int]` — Copied cache after prefix reuse/insertion/eviction, and matched prefix length.

Match consecutive tokens from the root, never arbitrary suffixes. Copy the cache and update timestamps. When full, remove the oldest unprotected node with no children; an ancestor becomes evictable only after its children disappear.

## 4. Conventions

cache maps nonempty token tuples to integer last-use times and must be prefix-closed. prompt is a nonempty tuple of nonnegative ints; capacity counts nonroot token nodes. clock is at least existing timestamps. pinned names cached nodes whose ancestors are also protected. Protect the current prompt path too; break LRU ties lexicographically by token tuple. Return (new_cache, reused_tokens), never mutating input even on failure.

## 5. Experiment view

Replay six prompts sharing system prefixes with capacities seven and twelve; compare prefill token counts with no caching and verify node capacity.

The chart is generated by the actual submitted kernel during T3 and by the reference during export. Values are synthetic teaching measurements, not GPU throughput or full-model quality claims.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Further study

Read the cited section and explain which dimensions or scheduling constraints the kernel preserves. Then extend the experiment beyond the stated fixture while retaining the existing contract. Larger models, real devices, and communication costs require separate measurement.
